recap.text: Imani, Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, Agatha, Carl, and Donut fight the Ball of Swine from the redoubt. Imani uses a pedicure kit to make Carl's toes glitter and unbreakable. She uses a glowing chain from a Gold box and a pig harness to pull thirty-nine residents in ten cars. Imani pulls a lever to launch a bomb, then raises a middle finger to the air before entering the third floor.

Imani, a level twenty-four Fire Spiritualist, tells Carl that Chris picked an igneous rock race. Chris fought Brandon, and Henry and Brandon died protecting the escape. Imani discovers transfer stations are prime numbers and Pookas hand out sedatives made by the Krakaren. Imani leaves a coupon book on the first floor and fights a worm province boss at stop 48. She provides scrolls for chain and places flamers around a portal to protect Carl, Katia, and Donut.

Carl tells Imani he found Chris, but Chris ignores her messages. Elle uses ice to block fireballs while the group avoids monsters in the water and orc archers near an oil rig. Chris messages Imani to say something else is driving his body and asks Carl and Donut to kill him. Donut drops Chris into a sealed chamber under the street instead. Imani organizes extractions for five hundred crawlers in eight bubbles, refusing to leave anyone with a feral god.

Imani raids a druid town and casts a counterspell to remove a glamour Eva used to charm the townsfolk. She tells Carl about her Smart Juice aura, which adds a level to a spell but increases the cooldown. After Signet enters the ballroom, Imani and Carl discuss the goddess's guest list. Imani uses counterspells and buffs while falling into a brambles' dome and heals people during a breath in Carl's shell.

Imani and Elle start in the Great Wolf Lodge. After a teammate uses a Bliss Surfing drug den, Imani is sent to Detroit. Her totem, the Amhuluk, kills four of her own squad members with a poison cloud, giving her four player killer skulls. In a training arcade, Imani cures mercenaries who leak slugs. After fighting demons with Tran, Imani wraps Carl and Donut in her wings.

Imani buffs a man aiming a trebuchet loaded with Dazzlers and puts Total Ear Protection on Donut and Mongo. She uses a barbed-wire tattoo of Carl's Tripper spell, drawn in yam ink and blood, to trigger traps in a castle. After the 105th teleports in, Imani warns them about the Madness. She and Juice Box watch Britney to see if she has an axe.

Imani and Elle use a military troop carrier to race. Imani discovers a sock sustaining Dong. She catches a reverse tooth fairy who asks for three hundred twenty gold. Imani holds a portal open for Louis and other crawlers before holding a sign that says You are watching real people die.

beats.headline: The good folks from Meadow Lark
beats.text: We came down out of Meadow Lark, the elder care facility, together: Yolanda Martinez, the Andrews brothers, Brandon and Chris, me, and Agatha, who none of us can quite place and who came with us anyway. Carl and Donut find us, and we sit down and trade stories, theirs and ours, and then we make a plan, because there are people depending on us and a plan is what you owe them.
beats.gist: Imani, Yolanda Martinez, Brandon and Chris Andrews, and Agatha leave the Meadow Lark elder care facility.

beats.headline: Twelve skulls by my name
beats.text: Carl sees the skulls beside my name. Crawler Killer, twelve. Brandon tells him what he can: that something attacked us right after the tutorial, that our residents could not move quickly, that what those things would have done to them was worse. I do not add to it. I walk a woman to the bathroom and make her open the door herself, and I give a man in a wheelchair a sip of water. When Carl says the six of us will fight the boss, I speak for the first time. I ask him how.
beats.gist: Carl sees twelve skulls beside Imani's name. Brandon says something attacked them after the tutorial.

beats.headline: The Ball of Swine
beats.text: Seven of us against the Ball of Swine: Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Carl, Donut, Agatha and me, fighting from the redoubt. It is the first time this group has fought as one thing instead of six people and a cat standing near each other, and it works. Afterwards I count everybody twice, because that is what I do, and everybody is there both times.
beats.gist: Imani, Brandon, Chris, Yolanda, Carl, Donut, and Agatha fight the Ball of Swine from the redoubt.

beats.headline: Twelve items for foot care
beats.text: Donut laughs at him. So I sit down with Carl and his pedicure kit and take out the tools one at a time and tell him what each of them is for. He does not need all twelve; he has to make a show of it. About fifteen minutes of work and the buffs come on. His toes glitter, and the bones in them cannot break now.
beats.gist: Imani uses a twelve-item pedicure kit on Carl to make his toes glitter and unbreakable.

beats.headline: Yog's Special Chain
beats.text: Someone had to stay with the residents while Brandon, Chris and Yolanda cleared out the Mind Horrors, so I stayed. Then we built a train. The wheels come off wheelchairs whose owners are gone; Brandon designed the cars and added ramps. The chain is mine, a scroll out of a Gold box: any length up to about a thousand feet, light as a feather, gone in thirty hours. Chris and I wear pig harnesses and pull thirty-nine people, ten cars, one glowing chain running from him, through every car and back to me.
beats.gist: Imani stays with residents while Brandon, Chris and Yolanda clear out Mind Horrors.

beats.headline: Open the damn door
beats.text: Carl is building a bomb launcher, and I ask the obvious question. Why don't we just open the damn door? We are in a safe room. Mobs get thrown out. So we test it. The claw comes through, the thing goes thwum and vanishes, and a moment after, its dot is rocketing straight back at us. Keep it open, I say. See if it learns. Ninety seconds, and it is back, this time from another hallway down. It does not. Seventy-five to a hundred and twenty seconds, every time. When the launcher is ready, I count down from three and pull.
beats.gist: Imani asks to open the safe room door, tests a mob, and counts down for Carl.

beats.headline: Last one down
beats.text: I am the last of us down the ramp. Carl and Donut stand by the hole and wave, and I wave back. I don't smile. Thirty-six residents went down ahead of me in buckets built from chopper wheels and hunks of wood, and Yolanda did not. At the scorched entrance to the third floor I stop, look up into the air, and raise a middle finger. Then I go inside.
beats.gist: Imani goes down the ramp and waves to Carl and Donut without smiling.

beats.headline: What happened with Chris
beats.text: Obsidian Butterfly, Fire Spiritualist, level twenty-four. The wings aren't physical; on the sixth floor I choose whether they fly. I came here to tell Carl about Chris. He picked a rock race, an igneous, got very strong, and it changed him. He wanted to spend every minute hunting and go find Carl and Donut. Brandon wanted to train near the stairwell. They fought, and several of the men left with Chris. Henry and Brandon died protecting our escape. Chris is the only one of those who left still alive. He won't answer us. He is looking for you, Carl.
beats.gist: Imani tells Carl that Chris is looking for him.

beats.headline: Primes, and the stations nobody has seen
beats.text: We trace our position on Carl's map and pick a stop where we can meet. Elle points out that every transfer station is a prime number; Mordecai had written the word in the corner and circled it. That is a pattern, not an answer. We don't have enough information. We need to know what happens at the stations every five stops, where the mobs all get off, and more importantly what happens at the end of the line. So my team takes one of the fifth platforms, and Carl and Donut go after an engineer.
beats.gist: Imani and her team take a fifth platform while Carl and Donut go after an engineer.

beats.headline: What the Pooka hand out
beats.text: Carl, we should stop derailing trains until there's a solid plan to get out. If other crawlers are behind you on the line, you may trap them. At the stops ending in five or zero, the mobs line up by race at doors with slots. Behind each door a Pooka hands out one vial of a race-specific sedative, and they take it back through a one-way portal. The description says if they miss their fix, they change physically. The Krakaren makes the drugs. I wasn't confident we could face her, so I had the team back off. Pookas turn into giant goats when attacked.
beats.gist: Imani tells Carl to stop derailing trains because they may trap other crawlers.

beats.headline: The coupon book she left behind
beats.text: Carl asks whether I got a PVP coupon with my skulls. I did. A Savage box with nothing in it but the coupon book, one for every member of the party. I tried to burn them and they would not catch, so I left them on the first floor. Brandon wanted me to keep them, in case. I could feel them sitting in my inventory. Elle got no book with her skull, and Donut told me about the two she got, so I think only the first in a party to earn a skull gets one. I tell him to talk to her.
beats.gist: Imani earns a coupon book from a Savage box and leaves it on the first floor.

beats.headline: Stop 48 is full
beats.text: We crossed at station sixty onto Carl's line, found his train parked, and went down to the stairwell at 48. It was full of festering ghouls, and we watched them change: worms come out of them, and they pull together into one giant thing that fills the room. A province boss. We all got achievements just for discovering it, and it let us leave. Now the wrath ghouls are stopping at 36. We are going to post up there and kill them as they come in, before they can do the same. We could use some boom jugs.
beats.gist: Imani and others cross at station sixty and find ghouls at stairwell 48 that form a boss.

beats.headline: A ring of flamers around the portal
beats.text: Carl's plan needs chain, and I still have a few of the scrolls that make it, so the chain is mine. The plan I'm less sure of. When the centre of the floor opens, nothing comes up at us, because it all falls into his portal. I tell them to secure the entrances and put a ring of flamers and mages around the hole in case something happens to the cart. Then they come through the hallways instead. When Carl, Katia and Donut stumble back out of one, burning with acid, I'm right there, and I take it off them.
beats.gist: Imani uses scrolls to make chain for Carl's plan and puts flamers around the portal.

beats.headline: Still Brandon's brother
beats.text: Carl tells me he's found Chris. He's in the same bubble as Carl. Chris still ignores every message I send. I hope the real Chris is still in there somewhere; he's the only non-resident left. Here we need a boat with armor. Elle's ice keeps the fireballs off, but we can't get near the oil rig for the monsters in the water and the orc archers. Carl says build a sub, like that's easy. We bought the shop interface on Donut's advice. And Carl? Don't kill him. Please. He's still Brandon's brother.
beats.gist: Carl tells Imani he found Chris in his bubble, but Chris ignores Imani's messages.

beats.headline: He's being controlled
beats.text: Carl says it is not Chris. It is. Chris has messaged me: he is petrified, and when his body wakes he will lose consciousness again, because something else is driving it. Then he asks Carl and Donut to kill him, and I will not send that on. Elle does. When Carl tells me he is sorry, I do not answer. Donut drops Chris through a hole into a sealed chamber under the street instead, and I thank her. Take all four castles, I tell them, then go back, incapacitate them again, bring them through the portal, and your game guide can make the potion.
beats.gist: Imani learns Chris is being controlled and asks Carl and Donut to kill him.

beats.headline: Nobody left behind
beats.text: Only eight bubbles meet the requirements for the first run: somebody with access to the Desperado Club, and every survivor in the same quadrant. Just over five hundred crawlers, most of them in the first four groups. The second condition is mine. I will not help a bubble out if it means leaving anyone in there with a feral god, not even one person. Elle can tell when someone is lying about their quadrants, and she has weeded a few out. Carl said not to wait for him. I tell everybody we are starting the extractions.
beats.gist: Imani starts extractions for eight bubbles, refusing to leave anyone with a feral god.

beats.headline: A counterspell in the druid town
beats.text: We raid a small druid town after Eva, and she has already gone. She leaves a glamour behind: she charmed the townsfolk and talked them into attacking us as we came in. When they approach, I cast a counterspell and take the glamour off them. A tree-person tells me, in tears, what she did to them. The raid ends without violence. I can fly now, and I move with Elle behind Katia, Florin and Bautista. Li Na can track her, and she is backed into the hot springs and the lava tubes.
beats.gist: Imani casts a counterspell on townsfolk charmed by Eva, ending a raid without violence.

beats.headline: Smart Juice
beats.text: Carl asks whether I have an ability that raises the level of a spell. I do. An aura called Smart Juice. It adds a level to a spell, but it adds an extra cooldown as well, so I don't use it much in a fight. Elle gets mad when her icicles take too long. He says thanks, and nothing about what he needs it for.
beats.gist: Carl asks Imani about an ability to raise spell levels; she has an aura called Smart Juice.

beats.headline: People are depending on us
beats.text: Signet is in the ballroom with us now, which means she can't help us from outside it. Carl says the goddess picks the guest list, so of course she brought in one of the queen's biggest enemies. I tell him I don't like it. It's like they've been one step ahead of us the whole time. He thinks it's better this way: she'll be the first target, and it buys us a few extra seconds if someone breaks the seal. Everything is going off the rails, and people are depending on us. He says he knows.
beats.gist: Signet enters the ballroom, and Carl says the goddess brought in the queen's enemy.

beats.headline: Counterspells on the way down
beats.text: We fall into the brambles' dome with the bugs, and I work. Debuffs stack on our people and I take them off, dozens of them, counterspells and buffs as fast as I can throw them, wings spread the whole way down. When Carl's shell gives us a breath, I use it to heal whoever I can reach. Then I point. There. The god is in the far corner. Then I go back to the fight against Imogen.
beats.gist: Imani falls into the brambles' dome and removes dozens of debuffs while her wings spread.

beats.headline: Great Wolf Lodge
beats.text: We picked the western United States and came up in an indoor water park in the middle of nowhere, the Great Wolf Lodge. Elle and I were put in different squads and made to choose separately, and we both chose the same place. It is rural out here, with I-5 close by. Only a handful of cars have come up from the south toward Portland, so something is blocking the freeway down there. There is chatter about this everywhere. I don't know if they thought this through, or if this is exactly what they wanted.
beats.gist: Imani and Elle choose the Great Wolf Lodge indoor water park in the rural western United States.

beats.headline: A drug den like a frozen yogurt bar
beats.text: She is okay, but she has a nasty debuff. She found a secret room set up like a self-serve frozen yogurt place: you fill a bowl, add toppings. She made herself something and it knocked her flat for ten more hours. Bliss Surfing, it says. I think she is reliving a memory. Fifty percent chance of a lot of strength when she wakes, and some chance of losing intelligence. Elle is guarding her. The way Daniel keeps making excuses for her is familiar to me. I am going to the guild to talk to Louis and Britney.
beats.gist: Imani is in a frozen yogurt bar drug den with a Bliss Surfing debuff.

beats.headline: Detroit, and nobody asked
beats.text: Everyone checks in; I make sure of it. We are scattered. Elle's squad is in Belgium, and I am not with them. Florin is in eastern Nigeria and has lost contact with Lucia Mar. Li Jun's crew is further into mainland China. Prepotente, after some prodding, is somewhere in northern Italy. I was given one choice: Detroit. It is where I grew up, and I would never have picked it. My key location is in the home of somebody I know. I do not elaborate.
beats.gist: Imani checks in and finds the crawlers scattered across Belgium, Nigeria, China, and Italy.

beats.headline: Four skulls, for her own squad
beats.text: We needed the last token. One of the enemy totems possessed two of my people and made them fight each other. Randall froze all four of them to stop it. Then my own totem, the Amhuluk, cast a poison cloud, and they died frozen in place. It finished the deckmaster and won the battle. The dungeon gives me four player killer skulls for them. I do not go to the final battle. I go back to the saferoom. Elle is the only one I can talk to.
beats.gist: Imani gets four player killer skulls after her squad dies frozen in a poison cloud.

beats.headline: Cuba, or face Elle
beats.text: At midnight they give me two choices: Cuba, or back to face Elle. I cannot do that. So I am in Cuba, at a church, and no traps went off. Carl says sit tight, they are coming, and not to let the nun through. Then I tell them the rest. A man here tried to start a card battle with me, and I got through the saferoom door first. It is Quan Ch, alone.
beats.gist: Imani chooses Cuba over Elle and waits in a church with Quan Ch.

beats.headline: The training arcade door
beats.text: Carl sends me to the training arcade, where he locked the mercenaries in almost a day ago with a disease that makes them leak slugs every few minutes. The room kills them and regenerates them. There are hundreds of slugs now, some as high level as the mercenaries, and the room is full of blood. I watch one swallow Steve whole. Carl says he only infected Doctor Bones, and Doctor Bones did the rest. The room healer refused to cure them because Carl told her not to. So I cure them. I am a healer. It's what I do.
beats.gist: Carl sends Imani to a training arcade full of blood and slugs that swallow Steve whole.

beats.headline: People have bones for a reason
beats.text: Surprise. We came out into the church, all of us, through the door Lucia's upgrade put in my room. We have already pooled our money for the barracks upgrade. Carl still wants to hand me his key. No. Elle tells him we're all in this together, and if it goes wrong most of us can still go back and use our keys. Donut told me about his other idea, the one where he uses one of his own bones to get out. People have bones for a reason, Carl. It's all or nothing.
beats.gist: Imani, Carl, and Elle exit through a door in Imani's room into the church.

beats.headline: I won't leave Tran
beats.text: Tran and I are trapped in a pocket of debris, and the demons are in here with us now. I am holding them off the best I can. Elle asks if I have cards left, a Flee card. Tran is on Katia's squad, so only her Flee card could take him, and she doesn't carry them, and she is out of cards anyway. So I won't leave Tran. And I don't trust my last totems. They are digging toward us from above.
beats.gist: Imani and Tran are trapped in debris with demons while others dig toward them from above.

beats.headline: Thank you for not giving up on me
beats.text: We stand in the tunnel under the X that Chris painted on the ceiling, the three of us, with three minutes left. I wrap Carl and Donut in my wings. None of us is getting out of this unscathed. We gain things, and we lose them. That is what happens in war. I thank them for not giving up on me. Carl says we don't give up on family, or what's the point. Then I put my arms around him too, and my head on his shoulder, and I cry quietly, with my skulls glowing over my head in the dark.
beats.gist: Imani wraps Carl and Donut in her wings in a tunnel under a painted X.

beats.headline: One trebuchet, and the buffs
beats.text: I drop into the trench next to Carl. I was buffing people down the line, and before that the man aiming our only trebuchet, which is loaded with Dazzlers. He's ready. I spread my wings and put a new line of buffs over everyone in the channel. Then Total Ear Protection on Donut, and on Mongo.
beats.gist: Imani drops into the trench and buffs the man aiming a trebuchet loaded with Dazzlers.

beats.headline: One over each shoulder
beats.text: Their diffusion spell strips every protection we had, and the heavy gun cuts through the ones rushing it. I stop over a veteran screaming, his arm gone. I put Donut's ear protection back, and Mongo's. Then I go for whoever is down. Into the crater with one over each shoulder. The Crest veteran is dead. The crawler with the arm blades is at two per cent and unconscious.
beats.gist: Imani carries a dead Crest veteran and an unconscious arm-blade crawler out of a crater.

beats.headline: This warlord thing suits her
beats.text: A group of us detour through Shanty Town and use the doggy door, and the moment I land in the castle the Extreme Focus buff doubles. Everyone in the zone is talking too fast, me included. Carl seems untouched, though his health screen says the buff is on him. I have told the medic already: check their pain levels after you heal them, outworlders heal differently. Then Donut is on the roof shouting Comrades, and Carl says she's been spending too much time with Rosetta. This warlord thing suits her, I tell him. It comes out a little sad.
beats.gist: Imani tells Carl that being a warlord suits Donut.

beats.headline: Carl's spell on my ankle
beats.text: We're inside the castle, and the slugs who were meant to go in first and set off the traps are dancing around a cart in a field somewhere. So I use Carl's spell. Tripper, lent to me as a little barbed-wire tattoo around my ankle, drawn by Katia in yam ink and his blood. Lots of traps go off at once. Carl says he got a notification when I used it, and it kind of hurt. I'm sorry about that. Donut says it had better have worked, after I disfigured myself for it.
beats.gist: Imani uses a barbed-wire tattoo spell on her ankle to trigger castle traps.

beats.headline: The person to your left and right
beats.text: The 105th teleports in, a few of them half inside trees, and I give Chris a quick hug with my wings. Then I fly the line. Keep an eye on the person to your left and to your right. The Madness uses mind magic and Atrocity magic, and they will not always show a notification. Call it out. And it is Carl they go for. Somebody slaps him awake, and I tell him to keep his eyes open. I cannot hold it until Prepotente gets here. Carl, cast Wisp Armor. He says there's no need.
beats.gist: The 105th teleports in, some half inside trees, and Imani hugs Chris with her wings.

beats.headline: No axe that I can see
beats.text: Britney comes out of the hospital tent behind Juice Box and me with her nose in the plans for the city's defences. I've looked her over. Her health is one hundred percent, and I see no sign anything is wrong. She doesn't have an axe, Carl; if she does, it's in her inventory. Juice Box feels nothing in her either. Elle says just ask her. Carl says not yet: if it's a presence like his, it might hurt her if it suspects we know. So we keep watching.
beats.gist: Britney leaves the hospital tent with city defense plans while Imani and Juice Box check her.

beats.headline: The table at the Lollipop
beats.text: The Lollipop, back table. I have a beer, and I slide Carl one, and Donut gets a Shirley Temple with extra cherries. Everyone checks in. Elle and I drew a military troop carrier. Tran is stuck in his garage. Zhang is not here: Li Na isn't really talking to him, and she killed almost every other team in their heat, so next race will show whether Prepotente is right about crawlers racing crawlers. Chris says his big rig is big but slow. Kinda like you, I tell him, and he almost smiles.
beats.gist: Imani gives Carl a beer and Donut a Shirley Temple with extra cherries at the Lollipop.

beats.headline: It's the sock
beats.text: Dong goes down outside the other team's garage and everyone assumes the Dominators cast something on him. I wrap him in my wings. There's nothing wrong with him now. What bothers me is where the sock was: he'd left it in our garage. Near it, he's actively healed and his health doesn't go up, which means it's sustaining him. Rosetta and Mordecai don't trust sapient weapons. If he's addicted, I don't know what to do yet. We don't tell him until we have a plan.
beats.gist: Imani wraps Dong in her wings and hides his sock addiction from him.

beats.headline: Two brothers, and no more
beats.text: I came over to get away from Elle's fan, Linus, and the slugs find me anyway. Donut asks how many brothers I have, in the present tense, and everyone flinches. I answer it the way it is. Full siblings, two. I was the youngest and the only girl. Then I tell Carl to open his boxes before Donut's blood bar drains, and I go and play, because somebody has to unlock Funky Kong if anyone in this room is ever going to beat Samantha.
beats.gist: Imani leaves Linus to avoid his fan behavior, but slugs find her.

beats.headline: Her card will not go back
beats.text: I get a notification: Jacobus is permanently summoned and can no longer be used as a card. I did not summon him. Carl did something. Now there is a fist-sized reverse tooth fairy doing laps around my head in Danish, asking my friends to show him their teeth and pay him three hundred and twenty gold. We are in a safe area. When he goes for Prepotente I catch him in my hand. No. He will not be doing that with any of my friends.
beats.gist: Imani receives a notification that Jacobus is permanently summoned and cannot be used as a card.

beats.headline: Crawler Henrietta's team is gone
beats.text: We pull onto the road just as Carl's truck passes, and now we are behind him. Elle is driving, like an old lady. We have lost a team already this heat. Crawler Henrietta, from Angola, new this heat. They hit a trap. It swallowed their mount whole, and she and her partner are gone. Carl sends us his course and asks about the cliff ahead. We have a wall-climbing kit. It is slow. He says he will wait until we are over, so we go.
beats.gist: Imani and Elle follow Carl in a truck while Henrietta's team vanishes into a trap.

beats.headline: Looking forward to this
beats.text: Donut has zapped Mongo into the bar so he won't miss Uncle Carl's stage debut, and the patrons are jumping back from his wings. Carl won't tell us why this quest matters so much. I don't need to know. I tell him the truth, and I smile when I do it: I've been looking forward to this moment for a long time. He says he hopes I like Norwegian music. Elle is going to be furious she missed it. I wave Chris, Florin, Bautista, Britney and Jurgen to the back, and suddenly the place is packed.
beats.gist: Donut zaps Mongo into a bar for Carl's stage debut; Imani tells Carl she looked forward to this.

beats.headline: Goddamnit, Carl
beats.text: He posted his plan for the eleventh floor to his page in the Book of Voodoo, and I left him three paragraphs on why it gets us all killed. He wrote back that he hopes I take a deal, that nobody would blame me, that I deserve the rest. So I told him: Goddamnit, Carl. This is insane. I still know he has no other choice, with Emberus coming due. My blood bar has an hour on it. The volunteers are gathering in Hungry Eyes, and Florin is choosing. Can we get on with this?
beats.gist: Imani tells Carl his plan is insane and warns that it gets them all killed.

beats.headline: That's not my dad
beats.text: Elle and I hit our gate in 310, and I cast Confuzzled on the room so the bugs stay stunned long enough for us to drop out. Carl calls the man on the floor my dad. That's not my dad. It's my uncle, and all that room shows is that he would have died even if I hadn't left. That's a good thing, honestly. I'm fine. The other me looks terrible, Elle says, and she's right. What I want to know is why Gucci's eyes weren't sewn.
beats.gist: Imani and Elle hit their gate in 310 and Imani casts Confuzzled on the room.

beats.headline: She will not take a deal
beats.text: Carl messages me that I've done enough and can rest. Oh, fuck off, Carl. He knows Chris won't take a deal unless I do. I know it too. I can't run from this any more than he can, and I ask him whether he's tried that speech on Donut. He has. It went how I thought it would. We're fucked, and I know it. I still think this is the right call. If we're going to lose, I want to go down fighting.
beats.gist: Carl messages Imani that she can rest, but she refuses to take a deal.

beats.headline: You run and don't look back
beats.text: Chris puts his hand on my face and says it isn't as warm as usual. He's wrong. This isn't goodbye, Chris Andrews. But promise me: if you get the chance, you take it. You see that exit and you're still in this body, you run and you don't look back. Even if it's just you, it'll all be worth it. He says he might turn back into a rock, or a dog. I don't care what he is. He says he loves me, and always has. Then he steps forward, waves, and drops away.
beats.gist: Chris puts his hand on Imani's face and says he loves her before he drops away.

beats.headline: She holds the portal open
beats.text: I open the portal again, and I hold it. Louis comes through, and the crawlers from the multi-crawler heats come through behind him, and I keep it open until the last of them is on this side. Everybody else goes back to the track, crosses the finish line, and takes the stairs. Somebody has to stand at the door. It's usually me, and I'm all right with that.
beats.gist: Imani holds the portal open for Louis and the multi-crawler heat crawlers.

beats.headline: Real people, just like you
beats.text: Mannequins, televisions, smoke. At the end we each hold up a sign. Mine says You are watching real people die, and on the back, Real people, just like you. Muchen, Qianfan and Lingyun hold up theirs, and Elle holds up hers. The AI likes it. Not going to lie: that felt good to get out. Chaco is still unconscious on the donkey. I didn't dare heal him as we passed. Somebody else did.
beats.gist: Imani, Muchen, Qianfan, Lingyun and Elle hold up signs for the AI among mannequins and smoke.
